chunks: Thus do We narrate to you some of the account of what has gone before, and We have given you from Us a Reminder.

key_terms.أَنبَاءِ: news or accounts of past events

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the stories of previous prophets in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the continuity of divine revelation, linking the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) to the lineage of earlier prophets through the concept of *Dhikr* (remembrance). It highlights that the Quran serves not merely as a historical account but as a living guide (*Dhikr*) that reinforces monotheism and prepares the believer for the Hereafter, a theme central to the narrative style of Surah Taa-Haa.
